versions.changelog: Add HTML Review, sharing and immutable review versions; document creator-scoped feedback and conflict-aware updates to the same Link. Correct Review publishing commands against the public CLI, add capability checks for newer CLI/server features, and distinguish saved private publications from verified access. Preserve first-publish telemetry and explicit audience selection.
Add one-command, privacy-safe first-publish activation guidance for the CLI-only OpenClaw flow.
Use the official Tunly CLI and browser/device login as the only executable OpenClaw path.
Use the verified CLI device-login fallback until the native plugin package has a signed published source commit.
Prefer the native OpenClaw plugin and device authorization; correct CLI authentication guidance.
Initial public Tunly artifact sharing workflow with privacy, versioning, and publish-to-serve verification.
